overrides.reason: HF2115 makes DHS responsible for detecting, preventing, investigating, and resolving fraudulent activity in human-services programs and requires county agencies to identify and recover overpayments. That directly advances state-program fraud oversight and accountability.

HF2434 adds provider program-integrity requirements explicitly covering fraud prevention, fraud detection, penalties, internal controls, and provider eligibility. Those are substantive anti-fraud oversight and accountability controls.

SF3045 standardizes reporting of suspected misuse of public money, resources, or data to oversight officers or the Legislative Auditor and adds explicit fraud-prevention policy. That directly advances state fraud oversight, transparency, and accountability.

SF3045 requires state departments, boards, commissions, offices, and agencies to ensure concerns about misuse of public money, resources, or data are promptly directed to designated oversight officers or the Legislative Auditor through a standardized process. That directly matches stricter state-agency fraud reporting.

SF2077 appropriates money for environment and natural resources, modifies and creates environmental and natural-resource programs and grants, and expressly applies conservation and resource-management principles. That directly aligns with strengthening conservation programs and protecting Minnesota's environment.

SF1959 appropriates more than $10 million per year for maintenance of Military Affairs training facilities and amends State Armory Building Commission powers. That directly provides building and facility resources for the Minnesota National Guard.

HF2435 creates section 144.124, requiring family-practice physicians, pediatricians, and other pediatric primary-care providers to give parents and primary caregivers materials on recognizing signs of physical abuse in infants and reporting suspected abuse. That is an exact substantive match.

HF2433 contains a career-and-technical-program expansion for an aeronautics and commercial over-the-road technical program and funds pathway-oriented education programs. That directly advances career-pathway opportunities and workforce readiness for students.

HF2435 creates a Rural EMS Uncompensated Care Pool Payment Program for rural ambulance licensees. Eligible responses expressly require that an ambulance responded, did not transport a person to a hospital emergency department, and received no payment from any source; payments are calculated from those eligible responses. That directly matches Backer's support for reimbursing rural ambulance services when essential on-scene care is provided without transport.

Scott's pre-vote source specifically supports childcare safeguards including video cameras monitoring infants and toddlers and 60-day footage retention. HF2435 creates the child-care-center video-security-camera section, requires cameras in infant and toddler rooms, and requires recordings to be retained for 60 calendar days. That is a direct substantive match.
